_about: Per-operation perf budgets in nanoseconds for the Rust implementation. measured = `cargo bench --bench hot_path -- --quick` parsed via scripts/parse_criterion.py. baseline_ns is the median (criterion's middle estimate) on the listed CI runner; tolerance_multiplier sets the budget = baseline_ns * tolerance_multiplier. All three OS buckets fully seeded as of CI run on commit b31a2ac. should_sample_logs carries a 10x multiplier rather than 5x: at a 14-32ns baseline its 5x budget left less absolute headroom than cloud-runner noise, and it failed at 70.9ns on macos-arm64 in a run where parse_baggage (2.61x) and sanitize_payload (1.72x) were elevated too -- a uniformly slow runner, not a regression in sampling. Same noise-floor rationale as the TypeScript import() and logger.info() overrides.
